paragraphs: Impero sells software that watches over school devices, led by StudentKeeper, which offers safety, monitoring and engagement features meant to keep students secure and focused wherever they learn. A second product, ContentKeeper, is the web filter in the same line.

School staff get real-time activity monitoring and granular access control. A single dashboard combines classroom tools, safeguarding alerts and compliance monitoring. Filtering reaches down to specific services, with granular access control for YouTube, Google and social media platforms. Clients run on Chromebooks, iOS, Windows and Mac. Districts can choose hybrid, cloud or on-premise deployment.

The pitch is to school districts that need to stay ahead of evolving digital threats while meeting the regulations that apply to them. Some capabilities are not shipping yet, including an assistive engine that identifies student engagement and wellbeing trends, marked coming soon. The footer identifies the business as Impero Solutions Ltd. trading as Ativion.

quote.text: StudentKeeper simplifies classroom management and digital safety through intuitive tools and unified reporting
